notice.title: Notification No.102/2026 dated 02-02-2026 for Direct Recruitment to the posts of Drivers in the Service of the High Court for the State of Telangana - Regarding.

relaxations.raw: b) The relaxation of maximum age limit in respect of SCs/STs/EWS or the Aboriginal Tribes in the Agency areas/BCs is 5 years.

clauses.text: a) Must have passed SSC examination or its equivalent examination, and b) Must be able to read and write Telugu / Urdu / Hindi or English, and c) Must possess a current valid light motor vehicle (LMV) driving license, issued by the competent authority under the Motor Vehicle Act, 1998 with…
d) The candidates should possess all the requisite qualifications as indicated above as on the date of publication of this notification.
a) As on 01-07-2026, the candidate must have completed the age of 18 years and must not have completed the age of 46 years.
To apply under this category, the aforesaid candidates must have put in at least two years of service by the date of publication of this notification.
